newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita Elec sees TV box sales 12 mln in 10 yrs.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita Elec sees TV box sales 12 mln in 10 yrs.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Wednesday it expects sales of 12 million digital television set-top boxes over 10 years for a joint venture it plans to set up with British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc (BSkyB) and two other companies.
It said half of that amount, or six million units, would be replacements for analog set-top boxes already in use by BSkyB viewers.
Matsushita expects the venture, which will include British Telecommunications Plc and Midland Bank SA, to be established by this summer at the latest, said Yoshio Hino, a director of the company.
"We are awaiting approval from the authorities, but the joint venture should be established by this summer at the latest," he told a news conference.

He added that Matsushita does not expect to be the only manufacturer supplying set-top boxes to be sold in connection with the venture. He said other electronics manufacturers had already expressed an interest in becoming suppliers.
Hino also said the new venture is expected to decide on specifications for the boxes very soon.
